visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a grey knitted beanie featuring a gold logo and a thick black puffer jacket sits at a light-colored wooden outdoor table. He is eating soup from a white cup with a black plastic spoon. A split-screen displays a top-down view of a lobster roll nestled in a wire basket next to a dark iced drink. The background features a paved walkway with green bushes and an outdoor patio heater, illuminated by soft, natural daylight. (2) The scene shifts to a detailed menu board titled "GRAND MENU" at "Luke's Lobster," showing various lobster roll options and prices. A person's hands are seen placing a wire tray with a lobster roll wrapped in branded paper, a cup of orange-colored soup, and a cup of soda onto the wooden table. The lighting remains bright and even, highlighting the textures of the food and the wood grain. (3) The man is shown in a medium close-up as he picks up the lobster roll and takes a large, enthusiastic bite. The lobster roll is filled with large chunks of red and white meat, topped with green herbs and a light red sauce. His facial expressions are highly expressive, showing wide-eyed delight and a satisfied smile. The background is a slightly blurred street with grey buildings and occasional passers-by. (4) The focus moves back to the soup, with the man stirring it and lifting a spoonful of lobster meat to the camera. Close-ups emphasize the steam rising from the cup and the richness of the soup's texture. He points to the food with his finger, gesturing to highlight its quality. The lighting is consistent with a cloudy winter day in an urban setting. (5) A hand is shown squeezing a small red packet of sauce over the lobster roll. The man continues to eat and react with exaggerated facial movements, including a "thumbs up" gesture. The video ends with a semi-transparent white text box appearing on the bottom half of the screen, providing store information and hours against the backdrop of the man finishing his meal.

The BGM maintains a consistent major-key tonality with bright acoustic guitar strums and a light percussive beat. (3) The acoustic texture shifts as the speaker takes a bite; faint rustling of paper and the percussive sound of a spoon hitting a paper cup are audible. The vocal tone shifts to one of exaggerated enjoyment, with rising pitch contours and increased loudness during the exclamation "讚啦." The BGM reaches its final cadence as the ambient city noise (muffled traffic and distant voices) remains as a constant, low-level floor. A final synthesized "whoosh" SFX accompanies the appearance of the brand's logo and closing information.
